gen-gf-crafty-girls-switzer: Crafty Girls looks jotted down in a hurry, loose pen strokes with curves that never pinch. Switzer follows in tall, wire-like sans letters, so a long page moves from scribble to something crisp and Swiss.
gen-gf-crafty-girls-work-sans: Work Sans is the modern half here, with a high mean line and joins as sturdy as its strokes. Crafty Girls brings the loose, handwritten warmth, while the sans keeps everything crisp and tidy.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-epunda-slab: Heavy, loud, impossible to ignore. Dela Gothic One shouts with big display weight, while Epunda Slab, the classic serif, answers in dignified tones with rounded lowercase and a gaping c.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One takes a literary, quiet tone below. Dela Gothic One hits hard above it with capital-sized lowercase, and the text serif's tall middle band and shallow ascenders leave the loud heading plenty of room to breathe.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-glegoo: Commanding is how Dela Gothic One lands, nearly capital-tall lowercase set in wide channels of space. Glegoo then settles in beneath, a serif with big counters and open curved mouths that keeps the page easy to enter.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-graduate: Graduate reads bookish and dignified, its letters traced with one marker and spaced generously. Over a long page, Graduate stays level, with capitals and lowercase close in height, so Dela Gothic One does all the shouting.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional text serif, high-waisted, with wide-set terminals on its s. And Dela Gothic One, heavy and commanding, makes that refinement feel even more composed beside it.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-kadwa: Dela Gothic One lands like a slammed door, its lowercase nearly capital height, with Kadwa following in open-ended curves. Big x-height, a serif that holds its own.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-noticia-text: Dela Gothic One is all commanding weight, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. But Noticia Text, a classic serif, keeps a long read literary, with big entrances into each curve and tall bodies.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Over a long stretch, Piazzolla stays open, each e pried wide like a clasp, a classic serif that never tires beside Dela Gothic One.
